title.narrative: Promoting gender-responsive village development in Uganda

description.narrative: Die Projektregion ist sehr ländlich geprägt und von kulturelllen Normen charakterisiert, die Mädchen und Frauen in ihrer soziokulturellen Stellung benachteiligen. Dies betrifft bspw. die Bereiche Bildung, Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten oder gesellschaftliche Teilhabe. The project region is very rural and characterised by cultural norms that disadvantage girls and women in terms of their socio-cultural status. This applies, for example, to education, employment opportunities and social participation. The incidence of domestic violence is also high and women have little say in family decision-making processes. In addition to these social problems, access to healthcare facilities is also difficult.
